name: Buried Worlds
summary: Step into the boots of a prospector and uncover treasure across five historic locations inspired by real discoveries. Sweep the ground with your metal detector, dig promising signals, pan rivers, sift sand, fish wells with a magnet, and carefully brush fragile finds. Sell what you recover, upgrade your equipment, and fund your journey to the next gold rush. Play seated or standing with teleport or free movement in this hands-on VR treasure-hunting adventure.
